decisions.reason: The request concerns Google indexing status and indexing-tool usage, not the required backlink count, delivery window, or link-type percentages.
The requested backlink-indexing information is separate from the completion report for on-page SEO tasks.
The source does not change the campaign keyword count, selected keyword, or mapped webpage.
Backlink indexing status and tool usage do not alter blog production, article count, publication conditions, or delivery.
The source concerns off-page backlink indexing and does not address missing image ALT attributes.
The backlink-indexing report request does not change the requested webpage content replacement or revision parameters.
This is a specific backlink-indexing inquiry and does not modify the weekly work-summary requirement or its Friday schedule.
The source does not affect the requirement to include three to four relevant images in blog articles.
Google indexing of created backlinks is distinct from internal links required within blog articles.
